titleFr: The Foundation of Chun Wah Morocco
descriptionFr: December 2015 – The beginning of Chun Wah Traditional Chinese Martial Arts Academy Morocco. This historic milestone marked the first meeting between Grand Master Teddy Lai and Master Bouchaib Soubai. During this meeting, Grand Master Teddy Lai officially appointed Master Bouchaib Soubai as his direct disciple and the official representative of Chun Wah Traditional Chinese Martial Arts in Morocco, laying the foundation for the academy's establishment and future development.

titleFr: The First Wing Chun Seminar in Morocco
descriptionFr: 25 December 2016 – Chun Wah Traditional Chinese Martial Arts Academy Morocco proudly organized the first Wing Chun seminar in Morocco, introducing the authentic Ip Man – Cheung King Kong Wing Chun lineage. This landmark event marked the beginning of the official promotion and development of traditional Wing Chun in Morocco, bringing practitioners together to learn directly from the authentic lineage and laying the foundation for future seminars and martial arts growth across the country.

2018 – Chun Wah Traditional Chinese Martial Arts Academy Morocco successfully organized the Northern Praying Mantis Seminar, bringing together more than 200 participants from across Morocco. This landmark event promoted the rich heritage of traditional Chinese martial arts, offering practitioners the opportunity to train, exchange knowledge, and deepen their understanding of the authentic Northern Praying Mantis system. It remains one of the academy's largest and most memorable seminars.

titleFr: First Hong Kuen Seminar in Morocco
descriptionFr: In 2019, Chun Wah Chinese Martial Arts organized her Hong Kuen seminar in Morocco, marking an important milestone in the promotion and development of traditional Chinese martial arts in the country.

titleFr: The First Mok Gar Kuen Seminar in Morocco & Africa
descriptionFr:
In 2020, Chun Wah Chinese Martial Arts organized the first Mok Gar Kuen seminar in Morocco and Africa, bringing together more than 300 participants of all ages.
The seminar was a remarkable success and became one of the most memorable and successful events in the history of Chun Wah Chinese Martial Arts Morocco, celebrating the practice, transmission, and spirit of traditional Chinese martial arts.

In 2023, Chun Wah Chinese Martial Arts made its strong comeback after the COVID-19 pandemic, marking a new chapter for our martial arts community.

This return was made even more special by the visit of our Grand Master Teddy Lai, who returned to Morocco after three years. His visit brought renewed energy, knowledge, and inspiration to our practitioners, strengthening the connection between the Chun Wah family in Morocco and its international lineage.

A powerful return. A renewed spirit. A new chapter.

titleFr: The First Chun Wah Morocco Visit to Hong Kong
descriptionFr:
In 2024, Chun Wah Chinese Martial Arts Morocco made its first official visit to Hong Kong, traveling to meet Grand Master Teddy Lai, his masters, and his family.

This historic journey was much more than a visit. It was an opportunity to strengthen our lineage, exchange Kung Fu knowledge, discover our martial arts heritage, and build lasting relationships with the Chun Wah family in Hong Kong.

A journey of friendship, cultural exchange, Kung Fu, and shared history  — connecting Chun Wah Morocco with its roots in Hong Kong.

From Morocco to Hong Kong — one family, one lineage, one shared passion for Kung Fu.
